Zhang Xiaohua was a washed-up artist who tragically passed away in a car accident after heroically saving a child’s life. After his death, Zhang Xiaohua’s soul was transmigrated into a parallel universe where the entertainment industry has become sluggish.
With a group of small musicians, memories and just his wits about him, he is forced to create something for himself in his new environment, working hard to sustain himself and his mother, while also trying to regain control of his father's company.
Follow his journey as he attempts to become a world-class entertainment mogul and conquer the entertainment world by storm.

Now I’m protecting him. And his beta best friend? Cold, calm, clearly hates me... and somehow looks hotter every time he glares.

retired-nice-guy-harem-system-unlocked:
So Mark was that guy who we call the mommy's boy. The kind of guy who will see students having a fantastic time breaking small, irrelevant rules and decides to tell the teacher to ruin all the fun.
Annoying, I know. And he learns that the hard way, a little too hard, actually.
No money, no food, no house, no bitches, no friends, no family. Nothing.
But when life throws him into a world full of MILFs — ahm, with varieties: women, beasts, elves, witches, devils, monsters, angels, fairies, demigods, actual gods —
that's when he decides to become an asshole who only cares about his own well-being. On his journey he will catch many MILFs and become the MILF master.
And a mysterious, freaky system will guide him, helping him evolve his body so he doesn't lose his dick in the process, and take advantage of the varieties this world has to offer.
rom-com-zombie-apocalypse:
When the zombie apocalypse hits, high schooler Mira teams up with her snarky best friend Elliot and the mysterious, crowbar-wielding Alex. Armed with nothing but a broom (yes, a broom), Mira leads the ragtag crew through a zombie-infested town. Soon, their biggest battles aren’t just against the undead—they're against hunger, exhaustion, and the question of why they're even fighting in the first place.
Rom-Com Zombie Apocalypse is a wild, funny, and a bit existential tale of friendship, survival, and finding meaning in a world gone mad.
sacrificial-bride-to-the-feared-lord-has:
At the last attempt for peace, Ophelia Valthorn is sacrificed by her ruthless stepfather, Joel Valthorn, to marry the feared Lord Dante Hastings. Ophelia is torn away from her sick brother, whom she loves dearly, and taken across enemy lands, where her every move is scrutinised, and every glance filled with hatred.
Dante and Ophelia are guarded against each other until the rise of assassinations and whispers of betrayal within each family forces them to lean on each other.
As Ophelia adapts to her new life, she discovers a curse which torments her husband. It is a curse which threatens not only the truce but Ophelia’s life.
Will Ophelia flee before war breaks out again, or help Dante break free of the curse?
saga-of-atlantis:
“Hah..Hah..”
In the midst of what seemed like a battlefield, a young boy with white hair knelt on the ground, struggling to catch shallow breaths. A short sword pierced his heart, his arms and legs were broken, making him unable to stop the crimson blood from coloring the ground.
“That's what you get for betrayal,” a red-headed teenage boy sneered as he stood before him.
“A pathetic person like you could never be my brother,” added a purple-haired girl, her voice seething with anger, as she stood alongside the redhead.
With great effort, the young boy shifted his gaze forward. He could see many familiar faces in front of him—his so-called family, his so-called friends but his gaze remained fixed on her.
“Wh..y, A.nna,” he uttered with immense difficulty and sorrow in his voice, his vision blurring as he locked eyes with the blonde-haired girl, who regarded him with emotionless eyes.
“I did that so I could save you,” he said, his voice gradually growing louder.
“I DID THAT SO YOU COULD LIVE!” he shouted, making everyone present flinch in fear.
“I never asked you to do this” the blonde-haired girl replied, her words crushing the very soul of the boy.
“A...nn.…
sign-in-system-starting-with-ten-draws:
Transmigrating after dying in a sudden accident, an overworked modern man wakes up in the body of a dying orphan in a brutal cultivation world, Starving, broken, and faces immediate death in a desolate ditch.
That is until the Heavenly Sign-In System awakens—granting him an unprecedented Ten Consecutive Starter Draws.
[Congratulations! You have won: Primordial Chaos Supreme Physique!]
[Congratulations! You have won: Sovereign Sword God Physique!]
[Congratulations! You have won: Slaughtering Immortal Sword!]
In a single ten-pull, his shattered mortal body transforms into an invincible vessel, unlocking absolute sword talent, max-level comprehension, and a thousand years of pure cultivation base.
While local sects clash over land and different races wage war for world supremacy, none of them realize the truth: their planet holds a secret cosmic resource that outer-world invaders will stop at nothing to claim.
Armed with daily gacha draws, a cold-blooded mindset, and endless ambition, Adam begins his silent, unstoppable march through infinite cultivation realms.
star-citizen-online-isekai-edition:
“So... well... I died as it seems?
Then I woke up as a character from an online science fiction game...
And the craziest thing was that I was in my personal spaceship...
Aside from that, I have this weird gaming system bugging me with missions and stuff...
So... finally, something interesting happened in my life at last.
At least now, I am unbound by anything and can do as I wish.”
- Acturus Al-Yesod Crawford
“In the grim darkness of the endless space, there is only one sole constant that has ruled the space since immemorial, that dictated the life and death, the order and chaos of every single living being.
Power.
This is the story of one of the most controversial people in the history of the Known Universe, Arcturus Al-Yesod Crawford, the Star Mercenary, Bounty Hunter, Trader and many other titles...…
the-crown-and-the-rose:
The light is here because the darkness exists. Just like that, the human realm exists because the demon realm is here. And in the great palace of the Blade Empire, a crown touches the peak of its glory before it falls from its grace. Lush Von Blade was the royal crown prince of one of the greatest empires on the southern continent. He is loyal but betrayed.
On the other hand, where even the Gods fear to set a foot on, a demon lord abides. His grace and cruelty have been unseen for centuries. He is the supremacy in the three realms. While Lush is the light, he is the darkness. Each exists because the other is here.
the-deadline-game:
When twenty-one-year-old horror novelist Arden Vale catches her boyfriend cheating with her sister Lira, she runs into the street and is killed by a mysterious bus. She awakens aboard Bus 000, trapped in The Deadline Game a deadly survival competition where 47 recently deceased souls must fight through seven nightmare stations for a chance at resurrection.
Each station is based on Arden's own published horror novels, forcing her to survive the monsters she created. Partnered with Kael Draven, a dead soldier who looks exactly like the man she secretly loved and lost two years ago, Arden discovers she possesses The Codebook a mystical notebook where anything she writes becomes reality.
But as players die and stations grow deadlier, Arden learns the horrifying truth: Kael isn't real he's a construct born from her guilt and grief. Her sister Lira orchestrated everything for revenge. And The Conductor running the Game is Arden herself from a future timeline, trapped in an endless loop of death and resurrection.…
the-god-eater-of-lagos:
Kade Adeyemi was born powerless in a Lagos where spiritual strength determines everything. He has no Ase Core, no bloodline, and no future—until the night his mother disappears.
That same night, a supernatural creature attacks him, and something impossible awakens within him:
[DIVINE DEVOURER SYSTEM ACTIVATED.]
Unlike ordinary cultivators, Kade doesn't grow stronger by simply cultivating Ase. He grows by devouring supernatural powers, absorbing abilities, bloodlines, memories—and eventually, the power of gods.
But every power he consumes changes him.
As Kade searches for his missing mother, he is drawn into a hidden world of cultivators, ancient spirits, divine artifacts, secret clans and beings that have watched humanity from the shadows for centuries.
Then he discovers something terrifying.
The gods aren't afraid of humanity.
They're afraid of him.
And beneath Lagos, something ancient is beginning to wake.
the-nightmare-wizard:
“Let the world burn… if that’s what it takes to keep them from stealing what’s mine.”
William Knox, once hailed as the brightest inventor of the century, dies with his heart corroded by betrayal. His daughter and closest friend stripped him of everything—his legacy, his empire, his future. But death wasn’t the end… it was only the beginning.
He awakens in a strange world, ruled not by science, but by magic. His body is no longer his own. His soul is bound by a dark contract, and his mind is still tethered to his past—thanks to a newborn AI and the last working prototype of his neural implant.
“Will you make a contract with me?”
Guided by the cold logic of his most innocent creation and the limitless power of arcane forces, William must survive among arcane kingdoms, ancient beings, and buried secrets that defy reality.
To succeed, he’ll need to master this new world’s magical laws, manipulate those who inhabit it, and uncover why he was brought here… and by whom.
Vengeance forged his soul.
Magic will shape his destiny.
And the truth… will destroy the world.
A story of magic, vengeance, and the birth of a new god of nightmares begins here...…
war-god-long-ao:
The young Long Ao, after ten years of obscurity, fell from a genius to a good-for-nothing, suffering endless ridicule and scorn.
After ten years of persistence and ten thousand failures, he finally obtains the Mysterious Dragon Seal.
With his Chaotic Dantian, he cultivates a Wudi Cultivation Technique, refines all things in Heaven and Earth, devours endless stars, sweeps across the desolate universe, and looks down upon the firmament! He asks the vast, starry cosmos, “Who dares to do battle with me?”
world-isekai:
Nobody thought the end of the world as they knew it would come like this.
In a dystopian future, 95% of the population was sent to another universe, one resembling the game Jack had played, “Elder Heir Online”.
He would've normally enjoyed such an opportunity, but the company 'DiveCore', from his real world, came along.
As long as any of them breathed, his revenge wouldn't be complete.
Using his knowledge of the game, and willingness to go through the worst to exact vengeance, he will slowly become what he avoided when he played the game in the real world: a villain.
